crew.name: Analyst
crew.role: Explains why a moment matters, citing the fact sheet for every claim.

crew.name: Telestrator
crew.role: Turns the story into grounded drawings on the pitch.

crew.name: VAR
crew.role: Fact-checks the story; can overturn it and send it back to the Analyst.

crew.name: Personalizer
crew.role: Rewrites the verified insight for analysts and casual fans in English, French and Arabic.
